clipId.description: clip: the clip; moment: optional, the clip that shows the moment when several do.

offset.description: Seconds added to the anchor point (negative = earlier).

at.description: moment: source seconds in assetId; time: timeline seconds.

quote.description: What happens at the moment, in words (e.g. 'right after she laughs').

ref.description: Transcript segment or insight ID behind a moment.

gap.description: after: pause after the previous beat (default settings.gap).

notes.description: A person's notes about this sound (kept with the cut; not heard in the video).

fit.description: auto: starts with the video and ends with it (smooth fade; a longer track ends on a beat near the end when it has one, a shorter one fades out early or loops); manual (default): exactly in → out from at.

loop.description: fit auto: repeat a shorter track until the video ends.

ending.description: fit auto: where it ends near the video's end. phrase: where the music starts its next phrase (else its next bar, else a beat); beat: on a beat. Absent: on a beat (music added before phrases were found).

duck.description: true: gets quieter while someone talks (by duckDb or the mix's depths); false: never; absent: as the mix decides.

delivery.description: How to say it (warm, slower, smiling): shown to whoever records and sent to TTS as context, never spoken.

fontFile.description: A font from the cut's resources (its short name); used instead of font.

logo.description: The brand's main logo (a resource name, usually logo): a graphic showing it shows the logo made for its background instead when the cut has one.

logoDark.description: The logo for dark backgrounds (a resource name, usually logo-dark).

logoLight.description: The logo for light backgrounds (a resource name, usually logo-light).

style.description: The look: clean, emphasis (the spoken word lights up), boxed, bold (big capitals for phones), highlight (a box follows the spoken word) or subtitle (plain subtitles).

size.description: How large the words are: small, medium (the default) or large.

source.description: transcript or dialogue = the clips' transcripts (default); voiceover = the narration (take word timings or the script); both = dialogue and narration; manual = segments.

showSpeakers.description: Show who is speaking above each caption line.

assetId.description: An asset ID, cut:<projectId>/<revisionId> for a cut from another project (nested, pinned to that version), or conv:<name> for a conversation the cut pins (its in and out are then seconds on the conversation's clock).

volume.description: Linear gain for the clip's own audio (1 = unchanged).

notes.description: A person's notes about this clip (kept with the cut; not shown in the video).

shots.description: A conversation clip's picture over time: one person, a layout, a text card or other footage, each until the next.

mutedMembers.description: A conversation clip: members whose sound is left out of this clip.

mode.description: speaking: each track gets quieter while its person isn't speaking (less echo and bleed when nobody wore headphones); off: every track plays at its level throughout.

name.description: The person's name (name tags, captions; per-person sound settings find them by it).

use.description: both: picture and sound of one person (default); sound: one person's audio; picture: a shared picture such as a gallery view (its sound is not mixed).

start.description: Where the recording starts on the conversation's clock (seconds; negative when it started earlier).

drift.description: Clock drift in parts per million: recording time = (t − start) × (1 + drift/10⁶).

tag.description: The name tag's second line (a role, from People's notes).

framing.description: How this person's picture is framed (fill or fit, faces, focus, zoom).

nameTags.description: Name tags in layouts: on (default) or off.

sampleAligned.description: Each recording plays exactly where its start says, to the sample (new cuts). Absent: from the cut's next frame, as cuts made before it rendered.

layoutStyle.description: How its picture-in-picture and side-by-side layouts look (from the layout pack). Absent: as they always looked.

enabled.description: Automatic ducking (default on whenever the cut has a voiceover or a mix section).

sourceUnderVoiceoverDb.description: Clip audio while narration plays (default -18 dB).

musicUnderDialogueDb.description: Music under on-camera speech (default -12 dB; a track's own duckDb overrides it).

attack.description: Seconds the level ramps down before speech starts (default 0.25).

release.description: Seconds the level ramps back up after speech (default 0.5).

mode.description: clean: on this machine, fast (less hiss and echo, softer harsh s sounds, clearer tone); studio: on this machine, slower and stronger (optional component); cloud: ElevenLabs voice isolation (paid).

strength.description: How much of the processed voice is heard (0–1; default 1: all of it).

off.description: Play the original voice (the settings and the processed copy are kept).

start.description: Where in the recording the copy starts (whole seconds).

variant.description: The processed copy (an audio asset with the recording's timing from start).

settings.description: The voice settings it was made with (who, how, how strongly)

ref.description: ID of a transcript segment or insight.

id.description: The person's line this fits (its ID).

original.description: The person's words for the line

text.description: Claude's words for the line (the same words when only the timing changes).

anchor.description: Where Claude starts the line (none: it follows the previous line).

kept.description: The person kept their own line here (Claude's change turned down).

sha256.description: The fixed copy: the SHA-256 of its file.

auto.description: faces: keep the main face in frame (from the clip's on-screen index); follow: move the crop with the subject as it moves.

focusX.description: Horizontal focal point kept in frame when cropping (0 left … 1 right).

pip.description: Picture in picture: where the inset sits, its size, shape and frame.

sideBySide.description: Side by side (and stacked): the gap, frame and what shows between the pictures.

targetLufs.description: Integrated loudness target (default from output.platform: -14 LUFS for social and YouTube, -16 generic).

normalize.description: Apply one static master gain so the estimated mix meets the target (default on for cuts with a voiceover; needs loudness evidence for the sources). QA measures the real render.

source.description: The clips' own audio (production sound) and dialogue tracks.

levelSpeech.description: Even out speech loudness between clips (on for new cuts; absent = off, as older cuts were made).

cutBlend.description: Seconds the sound blends at straight cuts so they never click (new cuts: 0.1; absent = none, as older cuts were made).

voices.description: Per person (by the name the speaker data shows) or per recording: a level change and a clearer voice over their speech.

enhanced.description: The processed copies (clearer voices) recordings play instead of their own sound; written by sound enhance.

said.description: Words changed in the speaker's own voice copy, with their consent: the new sound plays instead of the recording's own over each stretch. Written by cut say place.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the component's canonical source archive: the exact version a person approved.

libs.description: The shared libraries it imports (@metarush/lib/<name>) and their exact versions (SHA-256).

framing.description: faces: crops keep the main face in frame (new cuts); follow: crops move with the subject as it moves; center or absent: crops keep the middle (older cuts). A clip's own focus or framing.auto wins.

template.description: A vetted template (the default). Leave it out for a project motion graphic (or for a role the layout pack fills).

motion.description: A project motion graphic (motion/<name> in the project folder) by name and approved version, instead of a template.

role.description: The part it plays in the layout pack: title-card, lower-third, end-screen, quote-card or chapter-card (a variant after a colon: lower-third:guest). Without a template the pack fills it.

at.description: When the graphic starts (seconds on the finished video; with a span: seconds after the span starts).

duration.description: How long it stays (seconds; at least 0.2). With a span: 0 = to the span's end.

notes.description: A person's notes about this graphic (kept with the cut; not shown in the video).

span.description: Last a section ({from, to}: clip names) or the whole video ({}); at and duration are then measured inside it.

changes.description: Moments in the footage from which the graphic's fields change while it stays on screen (a name bar's name follows who is on screen).

footage.description: The footage the moment is in (a clip's assetId).

at.description: Seconds in that footage from which the new fields apply.

params.description: The fields that change (merged over the graphic's own; a picture field can't change).

from.description: The clip the graphic starts with (default: the first).

to.description: The clip it ends with (default: the last).

size.description: How large the inset is (default medium).

shape.description: rounded (default), square or circle (a round camera bubble).

frame.description: A line around the inset in one of the brand's colours (default none).

sha256.description: The exact version: the SHA-256 of its file. Updating to a newer version is an explicit change.

id.description: The change's record: who asked, whose voice copy and consent, and how it was checked.

from.description: Where in the recording the new sound starts (seconds; it begins and ends with the recording's own sound).

sound.description: The new sound (a clip MetaRush made, as long as the stretch).

picture.description: The stretch with the mouth matched to the new words (a clip MetaRush made, as long as the stretch).

at.description: Where it starts on the conversation's clock (seconds).

card.description: A text card (an off-camera interviewer's question).

in.description: Where in that footage it starts (seconds).

gap.description: The gap between the pictures (default thin).

frame.description: A line around each picture in one of the brand's colours (default none).

backdrop.description: What shows between the pictures: black (default) or the brand's background colour.

mode.description: cut: the sound changes with the picture; lead: this clip's sound starts early, before we see it (J-cut); carry: the previous clip's sound carries on over this clip (L-cut); auto: MetaRush moves the sound change into the nearest pause so no word is cut.

duration.description: lead/carry: seconds. auto: the most it may move the sound (default 1).

blend.description: Seconds over which one clip's sound fades out while the other's fades in (default: the mix's cutBlend, else 0.1).

notes.description: Editorial treatment summary shown to reviewers.

resources.description: Short name (lowercase letters, digits, - and _) → the resource and its exact version.

conversations.description: Short name → a conversation (several recordings of one talk, aligned) and how this cut renders it.

fixed.description: Footage (asset ID) → the fixed copy this cut plays instead of the original (steadier picture, cleaned-up voices…).

speed.description: Playback rate (pitch preserved). Fitting may speed TTS up by at most 8%.

aiVoice.description: Generated by a synthetic voice (TTS or a voice clone); carried into delivery sidecars.

useProcessed.description: Play the processed (cleanup) version instead of the original (A/B).

type.description: cut; fade (in from the background); crossfade (dissolve); dip-to-black / dip-to-white (fade through black or white); wipe, slide, push, zoom, whip (see metarush edit transitions).

direction.description: wipe/slide/push/whip: the way the picture moves (left = the next shot comes in from the right). Default left.

easing.description: How the movement or blend is paced (default ease-in-out).

name.description: The person as the speaker data names them (Maya, Speaker 2).

assetId.description: Instead of a person: a whole recording (one person's own track).

gainDb.description: Level change over their speech in dB (0 = as recorded).

original.description: The script exactly as the person pasted or imported it (never changed afterwards; a new whole script replaces it).

active.description: Which version of the script the lines are (original by default).

parked.description: The lines of the script version not in use (not part of the cut).

speakingRateWpm.description: Words per minute for fit checks of beats without audio (default 155; a recording sets the measured rate).

fitPolicy.description: auto: recorded or imported audio extends the shot and TTS speeds up at most 8%; ask: warn and wait; shorten: rewrite the line. Warnings are always shown.

gap.description: Default pause (s) before a beat anchored after the previous one (default 0.3).
